K enables Save shortcut and later appears under Assigned now after reopen and restart. All three paired native tab cycles keep the editor bounds stable. The compact chord shows Ctrl + Win + Alt + Shift + Space in full.
issue: The draft key is plain monospace while the assigned key uses a keycap. With a single letter, that makes the draft easier to miss than the recording and save controls.

issue: The nudge setting disappears without a nearby explanation of its dependency in the limited view.

label: Disconnected
detail: The disconnected card uses a crossed-out mouse and says saved mappings are editable. No device uses the same icon with different copy, while the connected view shows a half-filled green battery line and a separate DPI slider.
issue: The disconnected message mentions editable mappings but has no direct control to take the reader there.

label: 18 unnamed features
detail: Amber monospace IDs align beside feature names, including 0x2121 for Hi-res wheel. The unnamed IDs wrap into two chip rows with Copy unnamed IDs above them.
issue: The named list reserves a wide blank area to its right and leaves the end of the report very close to the viewport edge.

label: Couldn't save assignment
detail: The save error keeps the Back button and thumb photo in view and puts Try again beside Back to editing. The access-denied banner spans the top bar under a green Remapping on chip.
issue: The failed-quit banner and the green status appear together with no explanation of whether the conflict still affects remapping.

label: Open mouse settings
detail: The tray menu puts the Mushak mouse glyph beside the settings command and a check beside Start with Windows. Pause remapping changes to Resume remapping in the paused capture.
issue: The tiny app glyph is less legible than the native checkmark. The command wording carries the paused state.

label: Shell and profile switcher
detail: The Buttons heading sits beside Default; the open profile menu lists Preview app and checks Default.
issue: The helper text changes when the menu opens.

label: Button artwork and reported controls

issue: The extra control has no spatial location and markers obscure portions of the artwork.

issue: The list and diagram use different conventions for assignments.

label: Action editor and categories

issue: Action rows and categories are tightly packed and immediate selection has no explicit save cue.

detail: Copy produces an Edit result with Ctrl and C keycaps; zzzz produces No matching actions and a shortcut button.
issue: The empty-result dialog shows a scrollbar despite its short content.

label: Wheel button actions

issue: Assign and Set up use different verbs, so their different outcomes take a moment to parse.

label: Shortcut interaction
detail: Record key changes to Press a key, then M survives resize. Cancel returns to Native action; K saves and reappears after reopening and restart. Repeated tab switches retain the native assignment.
issue: The compact chord packs modifiers tightly and tab switching gives no explanation of draft handling.

label: Wheel settings
detail: SmartShift is selected beside Always ratchet and Always freespin. Flick sensitivity is 10 and Ignore accidental nudges is 4 of 8 steps.
issue: The nudge scale mixes steps and notches, making the value harder to interpret.

label: Gestures
detail: Swipe left maps to Desktop left. The off state says saved actions take effect when gestures are turned on.
issue: The 60 counts value does not explain a physical distance.

label: Profiles and window capture
detail: Preview app and Photo editor show numbered priority and reorder buttons. Picking in 6s leads to a python.exe chip and confirmation.
issue: The six-second window picker may be difficult for slower users.

label: Device status
detail: Device shows Bluetooth, firmware MPM 12.01.B0006, 50% battery and 1000 DPI. Disconnected and No device have distinct messages.
issue: The empty and disconnected states offer generic connection guidance without a troubleshooting action.

label: Device diagnostics
detail: HID++ features lists 0x2201 Adjustable DPI and 18 unnamed features, with Copy unnamed IDs.
issue: Hexadecimal chips and feature names are dense and the page gives little explanation of the IDs.

detail: The Logi Options+ warning offers Quit Logi Options+. A failed assignment says Copy is still unsaved and offers Try again or Back to editing.
issue: A green Remapping on badge sits above the red quit failure banner, making state ambiguous.

label: Tray menu
detail: The Windows menu changes Pause remapping to Resume remapping and checks Start with Windows.
issue: The menu does not show the current device or profile.

label: Shell and profile switcher
detail: The Buttons heading sits beside Profile Default. The open menu marks Default with an amber check and shows Preview app below it. The MX Master 2S connection card stays anchored at bottom left in both themes.
issue: No material issue visible. The theme control is a small unlabeled sun or moon, so its purpose depends on recognizing the icon.

label: Button artwork and reported controls

issue: The generic additional button remains physically unidentified. Name this button helps remember it but does not show how to discover which physical control it is.

issue: No material issue visible. The wider offline list leaves substantial unused space to its right and below, but the rows remain easy to scan.

label: Action editor and categories
detail: Thumb buttons shows a magnified mouse crop and Behind the thumb wheel beside the Back button editor. Selecting System exposes Task View, Desktop left, Desktop right and Show desktop. The compact modal keeps category names and shortcuts fully readable.
issue: The picker does not explicitly say whether selecting an action saves immediately. Its absence of a Save button suggests this, but the editor itself leaves the consequence implicit.

label: Action search
detail: Searching Copy replaces the category columns with one result under Edit and Ctrl and C keycaps. The empty result says No matching actions and provides Record a keyboard shortcut below a search icon.
issue: A scrollbar is visible beside the short empty-results body despite the sparse content. It looks unnecessary and slightly weakens the otherwise clean empty state.

label: Wheel button actions
detail: Switch wheel mode has an Assign button while Switch pointer speed has Set up. The speed editor shows 800 and 1600 DPI, Mouse now: 1000 DPI and Next press: 800 DPI above a full-width Save pointer speed action button.
issue: No material issue visible. The paired numeric inputs and sliders make the two speeds and next action clear.

label: Shortcut interaction
detail: The ordered frames change from Record key to Press a key, then show an M draft that survives the compact resize. Cancel returns to Native action. Saving K produces K saved for Back button, and reopening and restarting show Assigned now K with a green Saved label. Three native tab cycles keep the editor bounds stable. The compact Ctrl + Win + Alt + Shift + Space chord fits without clipping.
issue: No material issue visible. The full-size shortcut editor has a little extra vertical whitespace, but the saved, draft and recording states remain distinct.

label: Wheel settings
detail: SmartShift has an outlined selected card beside Always ratchet and Always freespin. Flick sensitivity shows 10, while Ignore accidental nudges shows 4 of 8 steps. The limited state removes both sliders and retains the two switches.
issue: The mixed units in Ignore accidental nudges require interpretation: 4 of 8 steps, half a notch and an endpoint of 1 notch describe the same setting in different ways.

label: Gestures
detail: Swipe left and Swipe right use amber arrow icons with Desktop left and Desktop right assignments. The off state removes Minimum swipe distance, changes the heading to Saved gesture actions and says assignments take effect when gestures are turned on.
issue: The visible value 60 counts is a hardware unit without an explanation or physical-distance reference. The Shorter and Longer endpoints help, but precise adjustment is less clear.

label: Profiles and window capture
detail: Preview app and Photo editor receive numbered priority badges and Move down or Move up controls. Picking in 6s appears beside Cancel. The final frame adds a python.exe chip and the confirmation Added python.exe to Preview app.
issue: The empty Default-only page explains matching but does not explain what adding a profile will let the user customize. The capture flow itself gives a clear countdown and result.

label: Device status
detail: Device shows Bluetooth, firmware MPM 12.01.B0006, a green 50% battery bar and Pointer speed in DPI at 1000. Disconnected tells the user saved mappings remain editable. USB mouse explicitly reports standard Windows buttons only and omits unsupported settings.
issue: The dark connected view gives Connection a narrow card and Firmware a much wider card, while the light view uses equal widths for the same content. This visible theme-dependent geometry is inconsistent.

label: Device diagnostics
detail: HID++ features lists amber hexadecimal IDs beside names such as Adjustable DPI and Hi-res wheel. Below it, 18 unnamed features appear as two rows of chips with a Copy unnamed IDs button and a sentence explaining their use in compatibility reports.
issue: No material issue visible. The diagnostic identifiers are dense but aligned, legible and separated from ordinary device settings.

label: Conflict and feedback
detail: Logi Options+ is running appears in an amber banner with Quit Logi Options+ and Dismiss. The save error says Copy is still unsaved and Your previous assignment is still active, with Try again and Back to editing controls.
issue: The conflict-error frame says Could not quit Logi Options+ while the title bar simultaneously shows green Remapping on. That combination does not explain whether the unresolved conflict still prevents mappings from working.

label: Tray menu
detail: The native menu lists Open mouse settings, Pause remapping, checked Start with Windows and Quit Mushak. The paused version changes the second item to Resume remapping while keeping the other entries and separators in place.
issue: No material issue visible. The small app glyph beside the first item is less visually substantial than the startup check, but the native menu remains clear.

label: Preview app
detail: The expanded Profile chooser checks Default in amber and keeps Preview app directly below it. The selected Buttons rail entry combines an accent bar, fill and icon.
issue: 03-Dark-menu.webp: The menu nearly touches the top of the mouse art. I found no material obstruction in either theme.

label: Spare button
detail: MX Master 4 adds marker 6 on the thumb panel and a matching Haptic Sense Panel row. Hovering marker 2 highlights the Back button row. The rename frames show Additional button 1 becoming Spare button under Outside the diagram. Offline frames retain the saved assignments and omit Scroll.
issue: 08-Light-extra-button.webp: The very short light-theme leaders over the thumb wheel make 2 and 3 harder to tie to the two physical buttons.

label: Gesture button tap
detail: Compact rows keep button names on the left and align the assignment controls in a second column. The gesture row shows Win and Tab keycaps beside Task View and a pencil.
issue: 03-Dark-button-list.webp: The offline footer says 'Save your changes here' directly below the list, where there is no page-level Save control. The instruction makes the next step less clear.

label: Select to assign immediately
detail: The wide editor pairs an amber pin on a thumb-button close-up with a category pane. System shows Task View and desktop actions, while Edit shows Copy through Find. The compact dialog keeps the same two list columns.
issue: 04-Light-category-menu.webp: The unselected action-row outlines nearly blend into the panel. This weakens the visual cue that each row is an individual target.

label: No matching actions
detail: A search for Copy shows one result under Edit with Ctrl and C keycaps at the far right. The empty state centers a magnifier above a direct Record a keyboard shortcut action.
issue: 01-Dark-search-results.webp: The result view drops the 'Select to assign immediately' cue shown in category browsing, leaving the effect of selecting Copy unstated.

label: Switch pointer speed
detail: The numbered Wheel controls crop points behind the main wheel. The speed editor pairs 800 and 1600 DPI inputs with sliders and shows Mouse now: 1000 DPI and Next press: 800 DPI just above Save.
issue: 02-Light-wheel-actions.webp: The current value reads Native action while the card offers a Switch wheel mode action. The panel gives no visible clue whether assigning the latter changes the button's current effect.

label: Save shortcut
detail: Both themes show three native alternations between the shortcut form and the Actions list. Recording shows Press a key in an amber panel. The compact resize retains draft M with Cancel and Save visible, and the cancel frame shows Native action. The save toast, reopened editor and frame labeled restarted show K, with the latter two displaying Saved. The compact four-modifier chord fits beside Change key.

label: Ignore accidental nudges
detail: SmartShift is the accented third radio card. The full page shows an amber 50% of a notch above the nudge slider, while the limited state omits the sliders and the compact layout stacks the mode cards.
issue: 08-native-compact-Light-wheel.webp: 'Invert scroll direction' says 'Push the wheel up to scroll the page up' while off, so the caption is ambiguous about which switch position it describes.

label: Saved gesture actions
detail: The off state uses gray arrows and says when the saved assignments take effect. The on state uses amber arrows and shows 60 counts beside the swipe distance slider.
issue: 08-native-compact-Light-gestures.webp: The initial viewport cuts through Swipe left and leaves Swipe right below the fold. A slim scrollbar is visible, but the tall setup cards displace two of the five mappings.

label: Picking in 6s
detail: The order screen gives Preview app and Photo editor numbered badges and puts Default underneath. The compact capture preserves the full cards and controls. The post-pick frame adds a python.exe chip and a green-check toast.
issue: 08-Light-window-pick.webp: The instructions, filled countdown chip and filled Add 6 seconds button compete for attention during a timed task. The add-time button sits apart from the picker it affects.

label: Disconnected
detail: The connected compact screen fits Bluetooth, firmware, a green half-filled battery bar and 1000 DPI. The disconnected and no-device cards use a struck-through mouse and place Edit button mappings just below. The USB state shows the standard-buttons explanation and Connection only.
issue: 06-Light-empty.webp: The empty-state instruction only says to connect a mouse, even though the separate Edit button mappings action offers useful work right away.

label: Copy unnamed IDs
detail: A fixed-width column aligns amber HID++ identifiers next to named features. Two rows of chips sit below 18 unnamed features and the copy control lines up at the right.
issue: 02-Light-diagnostics.webp: The width-spanning named-feature card leaves most of its right side unused, while the unnamed IDs and reporting instruction are packed near the bottom edge.

label: Couldn't save assignment
detail: The failed save panel retains the Back button identity, names Copy as unsaved and says the previous assignment stays active. It places Try again beside Back to editing. The conflict failure uses a red-tinted banner and gives the tray-menu fallback.
issue: 02-Light-alert.webp: Paused remapping is signaled in the title bar, the banner and the device card. The repeated status pulls attention away from the banner's explanation and remedy.

detail: The paused frame replaces Pause remapping with Resume remapping in the same slot. A check sits beside Start with Windows, with divider lines isolating the settings and quit commands from the middle group.
issue: 02-Windows-tray-paused.webp: The label communicates status through the next action. I found no material visual issue in the two native menu captures.

detail: Profile Default sits beside the title; the menu lists Default and Preview app with a checkmark.
issue: The menu overlays the mouse image, though its choices remain readable (03-Dark-menu.webp).

issue: The extra control has no image location and a generic name until renamed (07-Dark-extra-button.webp).

detail: The compact list pairs each button with an action pill and pencil, including Win Tab Task View.
issue: Four short rows occupy the top of a large empty offline page (03-Dark-button-list.webp).

label: Back button
detail: The editor pairs a thumb-button crop with categories and action rows. The selection has an orange outline and check.
issue: The chooser has tightly stacked rows and small category labels (09-Dark-compact-picker.webp).

detail: Copy returns one Edit result with Ctrl and C keycaps. An unmatched query offers Record a keyboard shortcut.

label: Switch pointer speed
detail: The wheel button editor shows two DPI inputs and sliders, current speed, and next press.
issue: The sliders have no endpoint labels of their own and rely on the supported-range sentence (03-Dark-dpi-editor.webp).

detail: Recording changes the prompt to Press a key. M remains after resizing, cancel returns to Native action, and K appears after save, reopen and in the frame labeled restarted. Tab-cycle frames alternate between tabs.
issue: Compact layout packs the modifier instruction and row closely (19-Dark-compact-chord.webp). These frames show states, not independent proof of input or persistence.

detail: SmartShift has an orange radio and border. Flick sensitivity shows 10 and Ignore accidental nudges shows 50% of a notch.
issue: Compact mode stacks three wheel choices before the other settings (07-native-compact-Dark-wheel.webp).

detail: The page names gesture button 4 as trigger, shows a 60-count slider, and lists tap and four directions with action chips.
issue: At compact height Swipe left is cut at the bottom and the remaining rows require scrolling (07-native-compact-Dark-gestures.webp).

detail: Numbered Preview app and Photo editor cards have ordering buttons and executable chips. Picking in 6s appears with Cancel; a later frame shows python.exe and a success toast.

detail: The profile menu sits beside Buttons. Default has a checkmark, Preview app appears beneath it, and the selected sidebar row has an amber left edge in both themes.
issue: No material visual problem observed. The numbered artwork and assignment column give the otherwise spacious page a clear reading order.

issue: No material visual problem observed. Position not reported explains the separate control. Offline frames explicitly say edits apply when a mouse connects. These are visible states, not proof of device behavior.

label: Gesture button tap
detail: Compact mappings align five rows with outlined icons on the left and editable assignment chips on the right. Close tab includes separate Ctrl and W keycaps. Gesture button tap has the smaller line Set swipes in Gestures.
issue: No material visual problem observed in the native compact frames. The roomy cards remain readable at 720 pixels wide.

detail: Copy search produces one result under Edit with Ctrl and C keycaps. The empty result state has a large search icon, No matching actions, and an outlined Record a keyboard shortcut button, with a clear-search X still available.

issue: No material visual problem observed across the 33 frames. The compact four-modifier chord fits beside Change key. Persistence after restart is inferred from the supplied sequence and frame label; the pixels directly show K and Saved.

detail: The wide Scroll view has three wheel-mode cards, SmartShift selected, Flick sensitivity at 10, and Ignore accidental nudges at 50% of a notch. Compact mode stacks the three wheel choices and retains both toggle rows.
issue: No material visual problem observed. The reduced-control frames are treated as reported capability and setting states, not missing UI. Both themes distinguish selected radios from off toggles.

detail: Gestures shows 60 counts above the distance slider and five directional mappings. Disabled gestures retain Saved gesture actions with gray icons and explanatory text. In compact mode the bottom mappings continue below the viewport with a visible scrollbar.

issue: No material visual problem observed. The compact profile cards keep reorder and delete controls on the title row. The completed capture is a visible result; underlying process matching cannot be verified from screenshots.

detail: Device aligns Bluetooth and Firmware cards above a green 50% battery bar and a 1000 DPI slider. Disconnected and No device use explicit status panels with Edit button mappings. The standard USB mouse view states it reports standard Windows buttons only.

issue: 04-Light-button-list.webp: labels and edit controls sit at opposite ends of wide, mostly empty rows. That makes it harder to follow the row across when editing several mappings.

detail: The Back button editor puts a numbered thumb-button close-up beside the categories. System shows Task View and desktop controls, Edit shows Copy through Find, and the compact picker keeps the category column in the dialog.

label: Choose an action to assign now
detail: The Thumb buttons crop puts an amber 2 at the physical Back button, and the same number labels the editor.
issue: The selected row and editor heading reinforce one another. In 01-Dark-popover.webp, Send Back to the app and Back are both visible, with their difference left to the wording and the Alt + Left hint.

label: No matching actions
detail: The no-results dialog centers its message above Clear search and Record a keyboard shortcut.
issue: The single Copy result includes its keycaps and immediately says what selection does. The empty state gives two clear ways forward.

label: Switch between two pointer speeds
detail: The DPI editor places the two number fields next to their sliders and spells out Current and Next press above Save.
issue: The wheel-specific choices, full action list and speed editor each communicate the next action clearly.

label: Keyboard shortcut
detail: The recording panel switches to Press a key, while the compact editor keeps all four checked modifiers and the complete chord visible.
issue: Recording, draft and save states are easy to follow. Across the native tab switches, 25-native-cycles-Dark-1-shortcut_tab.webp calls the current assignment Native action, while 27-native-cycles-Dark-1-preset_tab.webp calls it Send Back to the app.

label: Ignore accidental nudges
detail: The slider shows 50% of a notch in amber. The simpler state preserves that value in the high-resolution scrolling description.
issue: The mode cards show selection with a radio mark and outline. The settings below explain how wheel motion translates into scrolling.

label: Gesture recognition off
detail: The arrows lose their accent while the edit pencils stay amber, and the off-state copy says the actions remain editable.
issue: Direction icons and keycaps make the mappings quick to scan. The off state distinguishes editing from recognition, with some repetition in the text and status chip.

label: Pick a window
detail: The capture row puts a six-second extension beside Cancel. After capture, comet.exe appears as a chip beside preview.exe, and a confirmation names Preview app.
issue: The profile numbers reinforce matching order, and the inline rename keeps the app assignments visible. At compact width, 15-native-compact-Dark-long-profile.webp wraps the move and delete buttons below the full profile name.

label: Reported mouse features
detail: The connected view pairs a green battery bar with its percentage. The disconnected card offers Edit button mappings immediately below.
issue: The connected, disconnected and USB-only states make the available options clear. The battery and DPI use distinct visual treatments.

label: HID++ features
detail: The amber monospace IDs align in two columns, while unnamed IDs wrap into smaller chips beside a dedicated copy action.
issue: The arrangement makes a long technical list easy to scan. Copy device report and Copy unnamed IDs explain the scope of each action.

label: Remapping paused
detail: The paused chip remains after the alert is dismissed. The compact shortcut editor puts Applies after resume next to Save shortcut.
issue: The native captures retain the paused or resumed state at a fixed title-bar position across both themes. In 15-Dark-resume-compact-steps.webp the full-width instructions leave only two complete mapping rows visible, with Retry and tray guidance split across the title bar and banner in the unconfirmed state shown in 34-native-resume-Dark-08-resume-failed.webp.

label: Start with Windows
detail: A check sits in the left gutter, and horizontal rules separate Open mouse settings and Quit from the other controls.
issue: The menu is direct and familiar. Pause remapping changes to Resume remapping, although the menu relies on the command wording to convey the current state.

label: Buttons
detail: The sidebar highlights Buttons, while Edit profile shows Default and a two-option profile menu.
issue: The open profile menu appears as a wide horizontal strip displaced left of its trigger, obscuring the top of the mapping area (03-Dark-menu.webp). Overall 8: the shell is clear and restrained, but this menu relationship is awkward.

label: Buttons
detail: Numbered markers connect MX Master artwork to assignment cards, with an Outside the diagram row for Button 0x01FF.
issue: The raw hexadecimal button name does not identify a physical control, although the editor offers naming and explains the missing position (13-Dark-extra-editor.webp). Overall 8: the model-specific artwork and hover link are strong, with a real discovery limitation for unlocated controls.

label: Buttons
detail: The compact list pairs each button with an action, keycaps, and an Edit button.
issue: The wide offline list leaves a large unused area to the right and below the four rows (03-Dark-button-list.webp). Overall 8: scanning and editing are straightforward, but the wide layout feels underused.

label: Back button
detail: The editor puts a Thumb buttons crop beside categories, action rows, and shortcut labels.
issue: The category list and the action list compete at similar visual weight, and the action list needs its own scrollbar (01-Dark-popover.webp). Overall 8: the physical location and current assignment are useful, though the dense nested picker takes effort to scan.

label: No matching actions
detail: Search for Copy returns one row with Ctrl and C keycaps; an empty search offers Clear search and Record a keyboard shortcut.
issue: The empty state presents a useful recovery path, but its shortcut action has the same outline weight as a secondary control (04-Light-no-results.webp). Overall 9: the result and recovery states are concise and easy to understand.

label: Wheel mode button
detail: Mouse actions offers Switch wheel mode and Switch pointer speed, followed by a two-speed DPI editor.
issue: The two action cards use different verbs, Assign and Set speeds, without making the save flow equally explicit (01-Dark-wheel-actions.webp). Overall 8: the guided options are useful, but the mixed action patterns need interpretation.

label: Keyboard shortcut
detail: Recording changes New shortcut to Press a key, then shows the captured key and Save shortcut; saved state shows K.
issue: The initial shortcut panel says Assigned now Native action while the action tab reports Send Back to the app (01-Dark-seq-01-actions.webp and 03-Dark-seq-02-shortcut.webp). Overall 8: recording and saved states are legible, but conflicting assignment text undermines trust.

label: Scroll
detail: Wheel mode uses three radio cards, with Flick sensitivity and Ignore accidental nudges sliders and switches below.
issue: The selected wheel mode is clear, but Flick sensitivity's numeric value has no unit or explanation of what 10 represents (01-Dark-scroll.webp). Overall 8: the controls are well grouped, with a material interpretation gap in the numeric setting.

label: Gestures
detail: Tap and four directional swipe rows show icons, keycaps, assigned actions, and edit pencils.
issue: Minimum swipe distance combines 60 counts with an approximate 1.5 mm measurement at 1000 DPI, requiring users to interpret a hardware-specific unit (01-Dark-gestures.webp). Overall 8: the directional mapping is easy to scan, but the threshold is harder to reason about.

label: Profiles
detail: Numbered profile cards include application chips, Pick a window, reordering controls, and Delete profile.
issue: A long profile name pushes its ordering and delete buttons to a second line in the compact window, making the card much taller (15-native-compact-Dark-long-profile.webp). Overall 8: the priority and capture flow are visible, but the compact layout loses rhythm with longer names.

label: Device
detail: Connection and firmware cards sit above battery, pointer speed, and reported mouse features.
issue: The DPI slider displays a current value but offers no visible direct numeric entry (09-native-compact-Dark-device.webp). Overall 8: status and offline states are clear, though precise pointer-speed adjustment is less apparent.

label: HID++ features
detail: Named feature IDs form two columns, and 18 unnamed feature IDs appear as chips with a copy button.
issue: The unnamed IDs form a dense, undifferentiated block and their meaning is not available on the page (01-Dark-diagnostics.webp). Overall 8: the report is organized and copyable, but the unexplained raw IDs limit interpretation.

label: Remapping paused
detail: A persistent title-bar status offers Resume; errors show retry and tray instructions, and successful resume turns green.
issue: In the compact recovery state, the instructions wrap into a shallow banner above a partly visible list (15-Dark-resume-compact-steps.webp). Overall 8: the status and recovery steps are explicit, but the compact view becomes crowded during an error.

label: Open mouse settings
detail: The native tray menu shows Pause remapping or Resume remapping, Start with Windows, and Quit Mushak.
issue: The two menu states use plain native text with a checkmark for startup; no visible status appears beyond the changing Pause or Resume command (01-Windows-tray-active.webp and 02-Windows-tray-paused.webp). Overall 8: the menu is simple and readable, but state must be inferred from the command.

label: Buttons / Edit profile
detail: 01/03-Dark-menu.webp places the checked Default choice beside Preview app beneath the profile selector. The amber navigation rail, large Buttons heading and persistent battery card make the shell easy to scan.
issue: No material visual issue. Overall 9 for clear navigation and consistent light and dark treatment; the horizontal profile menu is slightly unusual but readable.

label: Buttons / Outside the diagram
detail: 02/11-Dark-marker-hover.webp links the amber number 2 on the mouse to an outlined Back button card. The MX Master 4 frames add a sixth Haptic Sense Panel marker, and 17-Dark-named-button.webp shows Spare button below Outside the diagram.
issue: No material visual issue. Overall 9 because the model artwork, numbered controls and naming flow keep even unlocated controls understandable without clutter.

label: Buttons / Configure gestures
detail: 03/05-native-compact-Dark-buttons.webp fits five mapping rows in the compact window, with Ctrl and W keycaps beside Close tab and a consistently placed Edit button at the right.
issue: No material visual issue. Overall 9 because the compact list retains readable labels, useful shortcuts and a clear edit target without clipping.

label: Back button / Actions
detail: 04/03-Dark-category-menu.webp highlights System in the left category column and aligns Task View and desktop actions with their shortcuts. The neighboring Thumb buttons crop shows the precise physical button.
issue: No material visual issue. Overall 9 for the clear split between physical location, category selection and immediate assignment, carried through the compact modal.

label: No matching actions
detail: 05/04-Light-no-results.webp centers a search icon above No matching actions and offers Clear search beside Record a keyboard shortcut. The successful Copy result uses separated Ctrl and C keycaps.
issue: No material visual issue. Overall 9 because the result and empty states are compact, readable and give a useful next action.

label: Wheel mode button / Switch pointer speed
detail: 06/04-Light-dpi-editor.webp aligns Speed 1 and Speed 2 numeric fields with sliders, states the 200 to 4000 DPI range, and explicitly shows Current: 1000 DPI and Next press: 800 DPI above the save button.
issue: No material visual issue. Overall 9 because the current state and consequence of the next press are both visible, with a strong save action and clear route back.

label: Keyboard shortcut / Assigned now
detail: 07/09-Dark-draft-actions.webp labels Keyboard shortcut as Draft and warns that choosing an action discards draft M. 23-Dark-compact-chord.webp keeps all four selected modifiers and Space readable in the short window.
issue: 07/03-Dark-seq-02-shortcut.webp changes the current assignment wording to Native action, while 01-Dark-seq-01-actions.webp says Send Back to the app. That generic wording hides what the button currently does just when the user is replacing it. Overall 8 despite the otherwise strong draft, record, save and reopen states.

label: Scroll / Ignore accidental nudges
detail: 08/01-Dark-scroll.webp distinguishes the selected SmartShift card with an amber radio and border. The nudge slider shows 50% of a notch, while 07-native-compact-Dark-wheel.webp stacks the wheel choices cleanly.
issue: No material visual issue. Overall 9 for clear mode selection, understandable descriptions and well grouped controls in both widths.

label: Gestures / Minimum swipe distance
detail: 09/07-native-compact-Dark-gestures.webp fits Tap and four arrow-marked swipe rows above the distance slider. The 60 counts value has a concrete explanation of about 1.5 mm at 1000 DPI.
issue: No material visual issue. Overall 9 because the direction icons, action chips and enabled state form an easy-to-read mapping list. The off state also explicitly says the actions remain editable.

label: Profiles / Pick a window
detail: 10/15-native-compact-Dark-long-profile.webp wraps Move up, Move down and Delete profile beneath Photo editing and color correction without truncating its name. The capture state shows a six-second countdown and an extension button.
issue: No material visual issue. Overall 9 for explicit profile precedence, readable application chips and a layout that accommodates long names without overlapping controls.

label: Device / Reported mouse features
detail: 11/09-native-compact-Dark-device.webp groups Bluetooth and firmware in paired cards, then shows a green 50% battery bar and amber 1000 DPI value. Disconnected frames offer Edit button mappings.
issue: No material visual issue. Overall 9 because device facts remain easy to scan and the disconnected and standard-mouse states explain what the user can do next.

label: HID++ features / 18 unnamed features
detail: 12/02-Light-diagnostics.webp separates named features in two columns from compact hexadecimal chips for unnamed features. Copy device report and Copy unnamed IDs have distinct positions beside the relevant content.
issue: No material visual issue. Overall 9 because the dense diagnostic content remains readable and the copy controls make its purpose clear.

label: Remapping paused / Resume unconfirmed
detail: 13/39-native-resume-Light-08-resume-failed.webp keeps the paused badge and Retry action in the title bar while showing tray recovery instructions below. 18-Light-resume-compact-editor.webp places Applies after resume next to Save shortcut.
issue: No material visual issue. Overall 9 because paused, resumed, failed and unsaved states have explicit wording and visible recovery actions. Compact frames retain the status and explain deferred application.

label: Open mouse settings / Resume remapping
detail: 14/02-Windows-tray-paused.webp uses a native menu with Resume remapping, a checked Start with Windows item and a separator before Quit Mushak.
issue: No material visual issue. Overall 9 for a plain, legible native menu whose pause/resume label makes the available action unambiguous.
